events.list.description: The name of the list of upcoming events on the events' screen, for assistive technology.

events.loading.description: In place of the list of events while the first of them load.

events.failed.defaultMessage: The events could not be loaded.
events.failed.description: In place of the list of events when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.failed_more.description: Under a list of an event's screens (the events, who is going, who answered a date) when its next page could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.more.description: The button under a list of an event's screens that loads the next of it.

events.retry.description: The button after a sentence that says something of an event's screens could not be loaded.

events.empty.defaultMessage: No upcoming events. When someone on this server plans one you can see, it shows here.
events.empty.description: In place of the list of events when there is none the reader sees.

events.back.description: The back button at the top of an event's page, which leads to the list of events.

events.event_loading.description: In place of an event's page while it loads.

events.event_failed.defaultMessage: The event could not be loaded.
events.event_failed.description: In place of an event's page when it could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.gone.defaultMessage: This event does not exist, or you cannot see it.
events.gone.description: All an event's page says when the server has no event at its address that the reader sees.

events.local_only.defaultMessage: Only people with an account on this server can see its events. Sign in to see this one.
events.local_only.description: All an event's page says to a visitor who is not signed in, over the sign-in button.

events.sign_in.description: The button on an event's page for a visitor, which signs in and comes back to the event.

events.cancelled.defaultMessage: {reason, select, moderator {This event was cancelled by a moderator.} organizer_suspended {This event was cancelled: its organizer's account was suspended.} organizer_deleted {This event was cancelled: its organizer's account was deleted.} other {This event was cancelled by its organizer.}}
events.cancelled.description: At the top of a cancelled event's page, by who or what cancelled it; the organizer's note, if any, follows on its own line.

events.date_polled.defaultMessage: The date is not decided yet.
events.date_polled.description: In place of an event's time on its page while its organizers poll its date; the poll follows below, under its own heading.

events.visibility.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, public {Shown to everyone on this server} followers {Shown to the followers of {organizer}} following {Shown to the people {organizer} follows} mutuals {Shown to the mutual follows of {organizer}} other {Shown only to invited people}}
events.visibility.description: Who sees an event, under its time on its page: organizer is the organizer's display name. Those invited and those who answered always see it too.

events.capacity.defaultMessage: {going, plural, one {# of {capacity} going} other {# of {capacity} going}}
events.capacity.description: How many answered going to an event that has a capacity, under its time on its page: going is how many, capacity the most it takes.

events.where.description: The heading of an event's places on its page, and the name of their list.

events.place_voice.description: The name of an event's voice chat room among its places.

events.place_physical.description: Said before the name of an event's place to meet in person, for assistive technology.

events.place_url.description: Said before the name of an event's place online, for assistive technology.

events.place_hidden.defaultMessage: {kind, select, physical {In person: the place is shown to the attendees the organizers approve} voice {Voice chat room} other {Online: the link is shown to the attendees the organizers approve}}
events.place_hidden.description: A place of an event the reader does not see, by its kind alone: it is shown to the attendees the organizers approve.

events.map.description: The link to the map of an event's place in person, which leaves the site.

events.room_opens.description: Under an event's voice chat room before the event starts.

events.room_opening.description: Under an event's voice chat room once the event started, before the server opened the room.

events.room_open.description: Under an event's voice chat room while it is open, over the button that joins it.

events.room_ended.description: Under an event's voice chat room once the room it opened ended.

events.room_cancelled.defaultMessage: Does not open: the event was cancelled
events.room_cancelled.description: Under the voice chat room of a cancelled event.

events.room_unavailable.defaultMessage: {reason, select, disabled {Could not open: voice chat is off on this server} not_eligible {Could not open: the organizer may not host voice chat rooms} too_many_rooms {Could not open: as many rooms were open as this server allows} other {Could not open: the organizer was hosting another room}}
events.room_unavailable.description: Under an event's voice chat room that could not open at the start, why; the event goes on.

events.join.description: The button under an event's open voice chat room, which joins the room and opens its page.

events.join_failed.defaultMessage: Could not join the room. Try again in a moment.
events.join_failed.description: Said when joining an event's voice chat room failed.

events.your_answer.description: The heading of the reader's answer to an event (going, maybe, not going), and the name of the answers.

events.answer.description: An answer to an event, on its button.

events.answer_full.defaultMessage: The event is full. You can still answer maybe or not going.
events.answer_full.description: Under the answers to an event whose going reached its capacity, when the reader is not among them.

events.answer_started.defaultMessage: Answers closed when the event started.
events.answer_started.description: Under the answers to an event that started.

events.answer_refused_full.defaultMessage: Not saved: the event is full.
events.answer_refused_full.description: In place of the line under the answers to an event when going was refused at capacity.

events.answer_refused_closed.defaultMessage: Not saved: the event started or was cancelled.
events.answer_refused_closed.description: In place of the line under the answers to an event when the answer was refused for an event that started or was cancelled.

events.answer_refused_unscheduled.defaultMessage: Not saved: the date is not decided yet.
events.answer_refused_unscheduled.description: In place of the line under the answers to an event when the answer was refused while its date is polled.

events.calendar.description: The button on an event's page that downloads its calendar file (.ics) to import into the reader's calendar.

events.calendar_saved.defaultMessage: Downloaded {name}. Open it to add the event to your calendar.
events.calendar_saved.description: Under the calendar button of an event once its file was downloaded: name is the file's name.

events.calendar_failed.defaultMessage: The calendar file could not be downloaded. Try again in a moment.
events.calendar_failed.description: Under the calendar button of an event when its file could not be downloaded.

events.calendar_unscheduled.defaultMessage: The calendar file can be downloaded once the date is decided.
events.calendar_unscheduled.description: Under the calendar button of an event when the server refused its file while its date is polled.

events.poll_heading.description: The heading of an event's date poll on its page.

events.poll_note.defaultMessage: Answering shows your name to everyone who sees the event.

events.poll.description: The name of the table of an event's candidate dates, for assistive technology.

events.poll_date.description: The head of the column of the dates in an event's date poll, for assistive technology.

events.vote.defaultMessage: {vote, select, yes {Can go} maybe {Maybe} other {Cannot go}}
events.vote.description: An answer to a candidate date of an event, the head of the column of its count and on its button.

events.yours.description: The head of the column of the reader's own answer in an event's date poll.

events.poll_loading.description: In place of an event's date poll while its dates load.

events.poll_failed.defaultMessage: The dates could not be loaded.
events.poll_failed.description: In place of an event's date poll when its dates could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.vote_scheduled.defaultMessage: Not saved: the date was decided, and the poll is closed.
events.vote_scheduled.description: Under an event's date poll when an answer was refused because the organizers confirmed a date.

events.vote_closed.defaultMessage: Not saved: the event was cancelled.
events.vote_closed.description: Under an event's date poll when an answer was refused for a cancelled event.

events.answered.description: The heading over who answered each candidate date of an event's date poll.

events.who_answered.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {No answer yet for {date}} one {# answer for {date}} other {# answers for {date}}}
events.who_answered.description: The summary of who answered a candidate date, over the button that shows them: date is the candidate's date and time.

events.vote_group.defaultMessage: {vote, select, yes {Can go} maybe {Maybe} other {Cannot go}} ({count})
events.vote_group.description: The heading of who answered a candidate date one way, with how many.

events.ballots_loading.description: In place of who answered a candidate date while they load.

events.ballots_failed.defaultMessage: Who answered could not be loaded.
events.ballots_failed.description: In place of who answered a candidate date when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.ballots_none.defaultMessage: No one answered this date yet.
events.ballots_none.description: In place of who answered a candidate date when no one did.

events.organizers.description: The heading of who organizes an event on its page: the organizer, then the co-organizers.

events.going_group.description: The heading of who answered going to an event, with how many.

events.maybe_group.description: The heading of who answered maybe to an event.

events.attendees_loading.description: In place of who is going to an event while they load.

events.attendees_failed.defaultMessage: Who is going could not be loaded.
events.attendees_failed.description: In place of who is going to an event when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.attendees_none.defaultMessage: No one answered going or maybe yet.
events.attendees_none.description: In place of who is going to an event when no one answered going or maybe.

events.vote_failed.defaultMessage: Saving your answer for {date} did not finish.
events.vote_failed.description: Under an event's date poll when the answer to one date could not be saved, beside a button to try it again: date is the candidate's date and time.

events.mark.description: At the top of an event's page, beside its glyph, as its line in a list marks it: it was cancelled (the reason follows under it) or it ended.
